sources.title: Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni | NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel
sources.snippet: Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning is NVIDIA's omnimodal reasoning model. It pairs a NemotronH (hybrid Mamba-2 + Attention) MoE language backbone with a RADIO v2.5-H vision encoder and a Parakeet (FastConformer) sound encoder, supporting interleaved text, image, and audio inputs.
